story: The first major mountain stage saw an intense battle for the breakaway, with 50 riders eventually escaping after a peloton split. Yellow jersey Healy was dropped on the Soulor. On Hautacam, Pogačar attacked with 12km remaining, quickly caught last escapee Armirail and soloed to victory, taking the GC lead.
